title: WorkshopOrder.linesJson (decoded)
description: PROPOSAL workshop-order: the lines of a pulled WorkshopOrder, as the JSON text in linesJson (WORKSHOP-BIKEBOOK.md section 5.1). Money inc VAT, at most 2 dp; qty at most 4 dp; at most 200 lines. lineTotal and vatAmount as the portal worked them out with the till's rule (qty x unitPrice; VAT = total x rate / (100 + rate)); the till recomputes and records any penny difference in priceDifference.

lineId.description: The portal's line id (what BikeBook uses on PUT/DELETE SalesOrderLine). Stable across versions.

externalLineId.description: BikeBook's own line id, or empty.

productId.description: A part's Product id (a single product or a variant); null for labour, custom and fee lines.
